name: Open Arms youth volunteering
what_you_do: Teens help in the kitchen, on the farms, or on meal deliveries. You work with Open Arms staff after an orientation.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up can volunteer in the kitchen and farms without an adult. Ages 12 to 15 need an adult who has done volunteer training. Deliveries need an adult driver (18 to drive alone).
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for an orientation.
how_to_apply: Register for an orientation on the volunteer page. Under 18 needs a parent signed waiver. Call 612-872-1152.
notes: Some equipment use depends on age.
